block_row: Structural top of the CAN FD controller. It joins the register side in the BUS clock domain and the protocol side in the CAN clock domain and holds no logic of its own.

frame_row: Structural top of the CAN FD controller: message handling and registers in the BUS domain, bit timing and protocol in the CAN domain, clock domain crossings in between.

label: u_rst
(m_canfd_rst)
blocks.function: Reset synchronizers of the two domains

label: u_csr
(m_canfd_csr)
blocks.function: Generated APB register block (APB-CSR-Generator, not hand-written)

label: u_wprot
(m_canfd_wprot)
blocks.function: APB write filter for the protected registers (INIT, CCE, lock)

label: u_cdc
(m_canfd_cdc)
blocks.function: Clock domain crossings CDC-003 to CDC-009 (wrapper of the synchronizer, handshake and toggle modules)

label: u_bsp
(m_canfd_bsp)
blocks.function: Frame state machine and field control

label: u_eml
(m_canfd_eml)
blocks.function: Error counters, fault confinement, last error code

label: u_rxh
(m_canfd_rxh)
blocks.function: Rx handler: storing, FIFO indexes, new-data flags

label: u_txh
(m_canfd_txh)
blocks.function: Tx handler: scan, fetch, cancel, event

label: u_mram
(m_canfd_mram)

label: u_pwr
(m_canfd_pwr)

interfaces.name: APB4 register access (CLK-BUS)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_apb_psel, i_apb_penable, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwdata, i_apb_pstrb, i_apb_pprot; TOP -> external: o_apb_prdata, o_apb_pready, o_apb_pslverr

interfaces.name: Message RAM master (CLK-BUS)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_mram_req, o_mram_we, o_mram_addr, o_mram_wdata, o_mram_be; external -> TOP: i_mram_ack, i_mram_rdata, i_mram_err_cor, i_mram_err_unc

interfaces.name: DMA request and acknowledge (CLK-BUS)
interfaces.category: handshake (level request, pulse or four-phase acknowledge)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_dma_req_rx0, o_dma_req_rx1, o_dma_req_tx, o_dma_req_txe; external -> TOP: i_dma_ack_rx0, i_dma_ack_rx1, i_dma_ack_tx, i_dma_ack_txe

interfaces.name: Interrupt lines (CLK-BUS)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_irq_0, o_irq_1

interfaces.name: CAN bus pins (CLK-CAN)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_can_tx, o_can_tx_b; external -> TOP: i_can_rx, i_can_rx_b

interfaces.name: Transceiver control and wake-up (CLK-CAN)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_trcv_en, o_wake_req; external -> TOP: i_trcv_wake

interfaces.name: Clock stop handshake (BUS and CAN clock)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_clk_stop_req; TOP -> external: o_clk_stop_ack, o_clkc_stop_ack

interfaces.name: External timestamp vector (CLK-CAN)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_ts_ext

interfaces.name: TTCAN trigger pins (CLK-CAN)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_tt_evt_trig, i_tt_swatch_trig; TOP -> external: o_tt_time_mark, o_tt_sync_mark

interfaces.name: Safety status and injection (CLK-BUS)
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_saf_err; external -> TOP: i_saf_inj

interfaces.name: Clocks and resets
interfaces.active: external clock and reset controller -> TOP
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_clk_can, i_clk_bus, i_rst_n_can, i_rst_n_bus

interfaces.name: Protected APB write path
interfaces.signals: u_wprot -> u_csr: filtered APB request signals; u_csr -> u_wprot: o_apb_prdata, o_apb_pready, o_apb_pslverr

interfaces.name: Interrupt control fields
interfaces.signals: u_csr -> u_irq: enable, injection and line-select fields; u_irq -> u_csr: raw flag loads

interfaces.name: Configuration and status
interfaces.signals: u_csr -> u_cdc: configuration fields (copied to CLK-CAN when init is 1); u_cdc -> u_csr: status snapshot fields

interfaces.name: Received frame transfer
interfaces.signals: u_cdc -> u_rxh: received frame, valid flag; u_rxh -> u_cdc: acknowledge

interfaces.name: Frame to transmit transfer
interfaces.signals: u_txh -> u_cdc: Tx frame, valid flag; u_cdc -> u_txh: acknowledge, frame result

interfaces.name: Frames, configuration and events across the domains
interfaces.signals: u_cdc -> u_bsp: Tx frame, configuration copy, commands; u_bsp -> u_cdc: Rx frame, status, event pulses

interfaces.name: Bit timing strobes
interfaces.signals: u_btl -> u_bsp: sample point, bit start, rate switch, received bit

interfaces.name: Error events and counters
interfaces.signals: u_bsp -> u_eml: bit, stuff, form, ACK, CRC error events, frame result; u_eml -> u_bsp: error state

interfaces.name: Edges for the delay measurement
interfaces.signals: u_btl -> u_tdc: transmitted and received edge; u_tdc -> u_btl: secondary sample point

interfaces.name: Rx message RAM requests
interfaces.signals: u_rxh -> u_mram: access request, address, data; u_mram -> u_rxh: acknowledge, read data

interfaces.name: Tx message RAM requests
interfaces.signals: u_txh -> u_mram: access request, address; u_mram -> u_txh: acknowledge, read data

interfaces.name: FIFO status for the DMA requests
interfaces.signals: u_rxh -> u_dma: FIFO fill level and watermark flags

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The two clock domains are asynchronous: the register side runs on the BUS clock, the protocol side on the CAN clock, and u_cdc holds the synchronizers and handshakes between them. Connections of u_pwr, u_pn, u_tt, u_ts, u_safe and u_rst to the other blocks are many-to-many and are listed in section 7 and section 18, not drawn.
